name: Seekonk Square
summary: Seekonk Square is an open-air lifestyle shopping center located on Route 6 off I-195, offering a unique blend of national retailers and dining options. Managed by WS Development, this convenient shopping destination serves the greater Providence and southeastern Massachusetts communities with quality stores and regular promotional events.
demographics: Seekonk Square attracts a diverse mix of middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the greater Providence and southeastern Massachusetts region. The trade area draws heavily from households with annual incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000, with a strong representation of dual-income families aged 30-55. The center serves as a primary shopping destination for residents of Seekonk, East Providence, and surrounding communities who value convenient access to quality retailers in an open-air environment. Shoppers typically visit for both planned shopping trips and casual browsing, with strong traffic during evenings and weekends from families seeking dining and retail options in a single location.
description: Seekonk Square is a premier open-air lifestyle shopping center strategically located on Route 6 off I-195 in Seekonk, Massachusetts, offering convenient access to shoppers throughout the greater Providence area and southeastern Massachusetts. Developed and managed by WS Development, this thoughtfully designed retail destination combines a unique blend of national retailers, local boutiques, and popular dining establishments in an attractive outdoor setting. The center's layout encourages a leisurely shopping experience, with easy navigation between stores and ample parking throughout the property. Seekonk Square has established itself as a community gathering place where visitors can explore diverse shopping options, enjoy casual dining experiences, and take advantage of regular deals and promotions. With operating hours from 9:30 AM to 9:00 PM Monday through Saturday and 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM on Sunday, the center provides flexible shopping times to accommodate busy schedules while maintaining its reputation as a welcoming destination for the entire family.
